title: #082. Two-Stage Lexicographic Optimization
subtitle: Minimize primary unmet demand first, then lock that Stage-1 performance within slack while minimizing secondary operating cost.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { selected, obj1, obj2 }.
judge.m3: Reported obj1 ({p0}) does not match computed unmet demand ({p1}).
judge.m4: Unmet demand obj1 ({p0}) exceeds allowed threshold ({p1}) from Stage-1 minimum ({p2}).
judge.m5: Reported obj2 ({p0}) does not match computed operating cost ({p1}).
judge.m6: Stage-1 requirement met, but secondary cost obj2 ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
